message.content: why do i need this api key

content.text:
You need it because the agent that negotiates has to call a language model on its own, and that model has to be paid for by someone — Tacto only runs the suppliers.

It's a different key from the arena one you already have:

- **Arena key (`ARENA_API_KEY`)**: identifies your team to Tacto. Done.
- **LLM key (`ANTHROPIC_API_KEY` or `LLM_API_KEY`)**: lets your agent's code ask a model to read the supplier's e-mail and write the reply.

I can't stand in for that model myself. In the Live Final the agent must run with no human in the loop, answer each supplier within 60 seconds, and handle up to 10 negotiations in parallel across five waves, so it has to be a program calling a model directly.

You have three ways to avoid buying API credits, each with a cost:

- **No LLM at all**: the naive agent needs no key, but it only haggles on price and ignores the data. It scored 0.58 on P01 and will do worse on cases where the win is in payment terms or index clauses.
- **Local model via Ollama**: you have `ollama` installed, and the kit supports it as an OpenAI-compatible endpoint. It's free, but a laptop model may be too slow or too weak for 10 parallel threads.
- **Your Claude Code subscription**: the agent could shell out to `claude -p` instead of using an API key. I haven't tested whether it's fast enough for the 60-second limit under 10 parallel calls, and subscription rate limits could bite mid-final.

My recommendation is a paid API key with a small, fast model. Tacto says their own reference agent runs on a cheap one, and a weekend of practice plus the final should cost a few dollars at most. If you'd rather not pay, I'd try the `claude -p` route first and measure its latency on the free sandbox cases.

# Git rules

## Commit messages: Conventional Commits

```
<type>(<scope>): <subject>

<body: why, not what — optional>

<footer: BREAKING CHANGE: ..., Refs: #123 — optional>
```

**Types**

| Type | Use for |
|---|---|
| `feat` | New user-facing behaviour |
| `fix` | Bug fix |
| `refactor` | Code change with no behaviour change |
| `perf` | Performance improvement |
| `test` | Adding or fixing tests only |
| `docs` | Documentation only (README, AGENTS.md, .agents/, comments) |
| `style` | Formatting only (ruff format, prettier); no logic |
| `build` | Dependencies, lockfiles, Makefile, the submodule pin |
| `ci` | CI pipelines |
| `chore` | Repo maintenance that fits nothing above (gitignore, tooling config) |
| `revert` | Reverting an earlier commit |

**Scopes** (optional, one per commit): `agent` (the negotiator package), `strategy` (negotiation logic in
`agent/src/negotiator/strategy/`), `kit` (the submodule pin), `repo` (root files). Omit the scope when a
change spans several areas.

**Subject**
- Imperative mood, lower case, no trailing period: `add item search endpoint`, not `Added item search.`
- At most 72 characters for the whole first line.
- Describe the effect, not the file: `fix(agent): retry a dropped reply with the same move id`.

**Body**: wrap at 72 characters; explain the reason and any trade-off. Required for `BREAKING CHANGE`
(also mark the type with `!`: `feat(agent)!: rename the run command to play-set`).

**One logical change per commit.** Formatting-only changes go in their own `style` commit. A strategy
change and the tests that pin its behaviour go in the same commit.

Examples:
```
feat(strategy): ask for a cost breakdown before the second offer
fix(agent): keep held RFQ threads alive while others negotiate
build(kit): update negotiation-arena-kit to the Sunday release
test(agent): cover the final-mode guard
docs: describe commit rules in .agents/git.md
```

# negotiator

Buyer agent toolkit for the [Tacto Negotiation Arena](../negotiation-arena-kit/README.md): a client for every
API endpoint, a runner that plays cases (RFQ threads in parallel, Live Final waves), full telemetry, reports and
statistics, and a baseline strategy to beat.

Python 3.12 (the arena starter kit requires it); the kit is a path dependency, so the published cost function
C and the quote-PDF parsing are exactly the arena's.

## Setup

```sh
cd agent
uv sync
# the key: ARENA_API_KEY in the repo-root .env (git-ignored); ARENA_URL defaults to https://arena.tacto.ai
uv run negotiator me
```

## Commands

| Command | What |
|---|---|
| `negotiator health` / `me` | arena up, data downloads / team, practice quota, best scores |
| `negotiator cases --set practice\|sandbox\|final` · `case <id>` | case files |
| `negotiator sessions --set …` · `session <sid>` · `thread <sid> <supplier>` · `backoffice <sid>` | our sessions, state, result + trace, threads, the supplier's back office |
| `negotiator attachment <sid> <attachment_id> -o FILE` | a supplier document |
| `negotiator board` | leaderboard (for people; refused in final mode) |
| `negotiator data` | download package v1 and the Sunday release into `agent/data/` |
| `negotiator play <case_id> [--strategy tactical\|baseline]` | play one case, with telemetry and a report |
| `negotiator run --set sandbox\|practice [--cases …] [--parallel N]` | many cases in parallel (default: every hosted case of the set) |
| `negotiator final [--parallel 10]` | the Live Final: waits for each wave, plays its cases within the cap |
| `negotiator report [run_id\|latest]` · `stats` | rebuild a run's report · best/mean score per case across all runs |
| `negotiator lessons [run_id\|latest]` | per case, worst first: score, cost blocks, the supplier's reasons per round, argument checks (also written as `lessons.md` after every run) |

Global options: `--url` (e.g. a local `arena-sim`), `--key`, `--json`, `-v`.

**Quota:** practice is 200 sessions per team per rolling 24 h; sandbox (`case:D01`, `case:D02`) and `arena-sim`
are free. Develop on sandbox and the simulator, spend practice deliberately.

```sh
uv run arena-sim serve --port 8100 --data ../negotiation-arena-kit/data          # local API, scripted supplier
uv run negotiator --url http://127.0.0.1:8100 register "Team" sim                  # a simulator key
uv run negotiator --url http://127.0.0.1:8100 --key <sim key> run --set practice
```

## Telemetry: `runs/<run_id>/`

| File | Content |
|---|---|
| `events.jsonl` | every event: `session_opened` (opening C per supplier), `plan`, `message_sent` (sheets with C), `reply` (status, terms, C, claim results, signals, latency), `attachment`, `thread_hold`, `decision`, `conflict`, `result` |
| `http.jsonl` | every HTTP attempt: endpoint, status, latency, retry, move id, pacing wait, practice quota left |
| `run.log` | the human-readable log (debug level) |
| `sessions/<sid>.json` | the whole case: case file, e-mails both ways, documents as text, decisions with rationale, result, the arena's trace and back office |
| `sessions/<sid>/` | the documents suppliers attached (quote PDF, cost breakdown XLSX, …) |
| `metrics.json` | counters (HTTP status, claim results, supplier statuses, timeouts, deals) and timings (supplier reply, decision delay after a reply, HTTP latency per endpoint, case duration) |
| `summary.json`, `report.md` | scores, C_open/C_deal/C_best/C_alt, price paths per thread, cost breakdown, claims, HTTP and timing tables |

## Architecture

```
config.py      settings from env / .env (ARENA_API_KEY, ARENA_URL, NEGOTIATOR_FINAL, …)
client.py      every endpoint; paced < 10 calls/s; safe retries with X-Move-Id; final-mode guard
telemetry.py   Recorder: events, HTTP log, metrics, transcripts, logging
data.py        data package in SQLite + facts.json; checkable Evidence (index moves, scorecard, notice, …)
profile.py     supplier traits from notes, letters, news, history (cash-short, approval ladder, hedged, …)
guards.py      hard rules before every send and accept: must-haves, alternative, valid sheets and IDs
lessons.py     lessons.md: what each case taught
session.py     Negotiation: threads, documents, costs (kit's C), send/accept/walk away, transcript
strategy/      Strategy protocol (prepare, decide, conclude, keepalive) and the baseline
runner.py      play_case (one worker per thread, keepalive, deadline), play_many, play_final
report.py      summary.json, report.md, statistics across runs
cli.py         the `negotiator` command
```

A strategy only decides; `Negotiation` performs and records. To add one, implement `prepare / decide / conclude /
keepalive` (see `strategy/base.py`) and register it in `strategy/__init__.py`.

**Tactical (default):** the category goal sets the policy (anchor depth, Boulware beta, reciprocity, which
levers to trade); the supplier's profile adjusts it. Concessions are counted in C: Boulware over the rounds the
round limit and the clock leave, capped tit-for-tat by the supplier's last move (no move from it, no move from us;
a half step after two stalls; the third settles the thread). Each round sends up to three sheets of equal C: our
C-optimal terms, a trade the supplier values (early payment for the cash-short, a long commitment for those who want
volume), a pure price move. Arguments are chosen by profile; irrelevant or contradicted kinds are dropped. A final
offer is probed once only when walking would cost little. The guards (`guards.py`) refuse any accept that breaks a
must-have (read on the quote PDF's standard terms; unknown counts as broken) or loses to the alternative. The tactics
are inspired by ASTRA (Kwon et al., [DSincerity/ASTRA-NegoAgent](https://github.com/DSincerity/ASTRA-NegoAgent)):
opponent modelling, an optimiser over the cost function, offers of equal value, tit-for-tat - no code taken.

**Baseline:** a target price from the lower of opening and current price minus an anchor per category goal
(floored at should-cost, plus the sustainable margin where squeezing the supplier costs C); up to three
checkable arguments (short notice vs. contract, index moves below the asked increase, weak scorecard,
should-cost, alternative quote, a cheaper rival in an RFQ); a concession schedule; three term sheets per round
(C-optimal terms, a pure price move on the supplier's terms, a shorter-payment variant at equal C); it holds a
thread on agreed / final offer / stall / close enough / last round and accepts the cheapest standing sheet that
beats the alternative.

## Tests

```sh
uv run pytest        # unit tests + end to end against a local arena-sim (started by the tests)
uv run ruff check . && uv run ruff format --check .
```

"""Settings from the environment, with `.env` files as defaults (real environment variables win)."""

import os
from dataclasses import dataclass
from pathlib import Path

PACKAGE_ROOT = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[2]  # agent/
REPO_ROOT = PACKAGE_ROOT.parent

"""The strategy interface. The runner calls it; `Negotiation` holds the state it reads.

Per thread the runner asks `decide(neg, supplier_id)`:
  message    send this e-mail (subject, body, term sheets, refs)
  hold       this thread is settled for now (agreed, final offer, close enough, out of rounds)
  drop       this thread is over for us (walked away, no bid, hopeless)
  accept     close the case on this supplier's standing term sheet
  walk_away  close the case without a deal
When every thread is held or dropped, `conclude(neg)` makes the closing move (accept or walk away).
While other threads still negotiate, a held thread's 60 s clock keeps running: `keepalive` returns a
message that keeps it alive (or None to let it be).
"""

from dataclasses import dataclass, field
from typing import Literal, Protocol

from negotiator.session import Negotiation

Kind = Literal["message", "hold", "drop", "accept", "walk_away"]


@dataclass
class Decision:
    kind: Kind
    supplier_id: str | None = None
    message: dict | None = None
    term_sheet_id: str | None = None
    rationale: dict = field(default_factory=dict)

    @classmethod
    def hold(cls, supplier_id: str, why: str, **extra) -> "Decision":
        return cls("hold", supplier_id, rationale={"why": why, **extra})

    @classmethod
    def drop(cls, supplier_id: str, why: str, **extra) -> "Decision":
        return cls("drop", supplier_id, rationale={"why": why, **extra})


class Strategy(Protocol):
    name: str

    def prepare(self, neg: Negotiation) -> None: ...

    def decide(self, neg: Negotiation, supplier_id: str) -> Decision: ...

    def conclude(self, neg: Negotiation) -> Decision: ...

    def keepalive(self, neg: Negotiation, supplier_id: str) -> dict | None: ...

"""Tactical buyer: category goal + supplier profile -> tactics; tit-for-tat Boulware concessions in C.

Ideas taken from ASTRA (Kwon et al., github.com/DSincerity/ASTRA-NegoAgent) - the tactics, not the
code: a model of the opponent, an optimiser over the published cost function, several offers of
equal value to us that differ in what they give the supplier, and concessions that answer the
supplier's (no move from it, no move from us).

Per case (prepare):
  - the category goal sets the policy: how deep we anchor, how slowly we concede (Boulware beta),
    how much of the supplier's move we answer (reciprocity), whether we protect its margin;
  - the supplier's profile (profile.py) adjusts it: idle capacity -> anchor deeper; fully booked or
    below cost -> shallower; cash-short -> offer early payment; hedged -> skip index arguments ...;
  - target C: the deepest credible price (anchor, should-cost, history, alternative), never below
    what the supplier can sell at (its full cost, plus the sustainable margin where squeezing costs C).

Per round (decide), all in C (our total cost, the score's currency):
  - their concession = drop of C of their standing sheet; ours = drop of the C we ask for;
  - next ask: the Boulware curve over the rounds we can still play (round limit and the clock),
    capped by reciprocity - if they did not move, we hold (then a half step to break a deadlock;
    the third stall settles the thread);
  - up to three term sheets at that same C: our C-optimal terms; a trade the supplier values
    (early payment for the cash-short, a long commitment for those who want volume or security);
    a pure price move on its own terms. Whatever it agrees to costs us the same.
  - arguments: checkable evidence picked by the profile; what came back irrelevant or contradicted
    is not used again.
Closing: the cheapest standing sheet that passes the guards (guards.py), else walk away; a
`final_offer` is probed once with a trade when walking would cost us little.
"""

import math
from dataclasses import dataclass, field

from arena_kit.cost import RELATIONSHIP_GOALS, complete_offer

from negotiator.data import Evidence, WorldData
from negotiator.guards import accept_problems
from negotiator.profile import SupplierProfile, build_profile
from negotiator.session import Negotiation
from negotiator.strategy.base import Decision
from negotiator.strategy.baseline import SIGNATURE, BaselineStrategy, describe
from negotiator.telemetry import log


@dataclass(frozen=True)
class Policy:
    anchor: float  # first ask: this share below the reference price
    beta: float  # Boulware exponent: > 1 concedes late
    reciprocity: float  # share of the supplier's last concession (in C) we answer at most
    markup: float  # floor vs the supplier's full cost when its margin does not cost us C (suppliers have
    # sold below full cost to keep volume: a leverage floor may sit a little under it)
    claims_first: int = 3  # arguments in the first e-mail
    trade_first: tuple[str, ...] = ()  # levers to offer the supplier, in order


POLICIES = {
    "leverage": Policy(anchor=0.10, beta=3.0, reciprocity=0.6, markup=-0.03),
    "routine": Policy(anchor=0.07, beta=2.0, reciprocity=0.8, markup=0.0),
    "quality_first": Policy(anchor=0.05, beta=2.5, reciprocity=0.8, markup=0.0, trade_first=("contract_months",)),
    "stabilise": Policy(
        anchor=0.04, beta=2.0, reciprocity=1.0, markup=0.0, trade_first=("contract_months", "volume_per_year")
    ),
    "secure_supply": Policy(
        anchor=0.03, beta=1.8, reciprocity=1.0, markup=0.0, trade_first=("contract_months", "volume_per_year")
    ),
}
DEFAULT_POLICY = POLICIES["routine"]
STALL_EPS = 0.0005  # a C move below 0.05 % is no move
DONE_EPS = 0.001  # our ask within 0.1 % of their C: nothing left worth a round
MAX_ANCHOR = 0.15  # the first ask never lies more than 15 % below the supplier's quote
EVIDENCE_FIRST = {  # profile trait / goal -> evidence kinds to put first
    "not_tracking_costs": ["index"],
    "open_book": ["should_cost"],
    "quality_first": ["quality", "scorecard"],
}


@dataclass
class Plan:
    supplier_id: str
    name: str
    policy: Policy
    profile: SupplierProfile
    open_c: float
    target_c: float
    floor_price: float | None
    full_cost: float | None
    evidence: list[Evidence] = field(default_factory=list)
    banned_kinds: set[str] = field(default_factory=set)
    our_c: list[float] = field(default_factory=list)  # the C we asked for, per round
    last_claims: list[Evidence] = field(default_factory=list)
    seen_replies: int = 0
    stalls: int = 0
    probed_final: bool = False
    asked_breakdown: bool = False
    breakdown_read: bool = False


class TacticalStrategy(BaselineStrategy):
    name = "tactical"

    def __init__(self, data: WorldData | None = None) -> None:
        super().__init__(data)
        self.tplans: dict[str, Plan] = {}
        self.banned_case_kinds: set[str] = set()  # contradicted: never again in this case

    # ------------------------------------------------------------------ prepare
    def prepare(self, neg: Negotiation) -> None:
        buyer = neg.buyer
        goal = buyer.get("category_goal", "routine")
        parts = neg.case.get("parts", [])
        current = buyer.get("current_unit_price")
        for sid, thread in neg.threads.items():
            _, terms = thread.standing
            profile = build_profile(self.data, sid, neg.case)
            policy = self._policy(goal, profile)
            full_cost = self._full_cost(parts, sid)
            self._estimate_supplier(neg, sid, full_cost, profile)
            floor = self._floor(neg, full_cost, policy)
            open_c = neg.cost(sid, terms)
            target_c = self._target_c(neg, sid, terms, policy, profile, floor, current)
            plan = Plan(sid, self._name(sid), policy, profile, open_c, target_c, floor, full_cost)
            plan.evidence = self._evidence(neg, sid, terms.get("unit_price"), current) if terms else []
            if profile.has("hedged"):
                plan.banned_kinds.add("index")  # "not our reality" until its hedge runs out
            self.tplans[sid] = plan
            neg.recorder.event(
                "plan",
                session_id=neg.session_id,
                case_id=neg.case_id,
                supplier_id=sid,
                strategy=self.name,
                goal=goal,
                policy=policy.__dict__,
                profile=profile.summary(),
                trait_refs=profile.traits,
                open_price=terms.get("unit_price"),
                open_c=open_c,
                target_c=target_c,
                c_alt=neg.c_alt,
                floor_price=floor,
                full_cost=full_cost,
                evidence=[{"kind": e.kind, "refs": e.refs, "sentence": e.sentence} for e in plan.evidence],
            )
            log.info(
                "%s plan [%s %s]: C open %s target %s floor %s",
                sid,
                goal,
                ",".join(sorted(profile.traits)) or "-",
                _k(open_c),
                _k(target_c),
                floor,
            )

    def _policy(self, goal: str, p: SupplierProfile) -> Policy:
        base = POLICIES.get(goal, DEFAULT_POLICY)
        anchor, beta, recip = base.anchor, base.beta, base.reciprocity
        trade = list(base.trade_first)
        if p.has("underutilised"):
            anchor, beta = anchor + 0.03, beta + 0.5
        markup = base.markup
        if p.has("full_order_book") or p.has("below_cost"):
            anchor = max(0.02, anchor - 0.03)
            markup = max(markup, 0.0)  # no room under its cost: it is already there or does not need us
        if p.has("price_frozen"):
            anchor = max(0.02, anchor - 0.02)
        if p.has("approval_ladder"):
            beta += 0.5  # it moves in small approved steps: no reason for us to move fast
        if p.has("cash_short"):
            trade.insert(0, "payment_days")
        if p.has("wants_volume") or p.has("full_order_book") or p.has("price_frozen"):
            trade += ["contract_months", "volume_per_year"]
        if p.has("we_pay_late") or p.has("relationship"):
            recip = min(1.0, recip + 0.1)
        return Policy(anchor, beta, recip, markup, base.claims_first, tuple(dict.fromkeys(trade)))

    def _full_cost(self, parts: list[str], supplier_id: str) -> float | None:
        """The should-cost of THIS supplier's plant for a single-part case; None otherwise.

        Another supplier's estimate is a different plant (cost base, process) and a bundle's price is
        not one part's cost: guessing would push the floor and the margin charge the wrong way."""
        if not self.data or len(parts) != 1:
            return None
        rows = self.data.query(
            "SELECT unit_cost FROM should_cost WHERE part_id = ? AND supplier_id = ? ORDER BY estimate_date DESC",
            (parts[0], supplier_id),
        )
        return rows[0]["unit_cost"] if rows and rows[0]["unit_cost"] else None

    def _estimate_supplier(self, neg: Negotiation, sid: str, full_cost: float | None, p: SupplierProfile) -> None:
        """Our estimate of the supplier for the relationship term in C (stabilise, secure_supply)."""
        if neg.buyer.get("category_goal") not in RELATIONSHIP_GOALS or not full_cost:
            neg.supplier_estimates.pop(sid, None)
            return
        std = neg.threads[sid].standard_terms
        if not {"payment_days", "incoterm"} <= std.keys():
            return
        rate = neg.buyer.get("interest_rate", 0.08)
        neg.supplier_estimates[sid] = {
            "full_cost": full_cost,
            "interest_rate": rate * 2 if p.has("cash_short") else rate,  # money now is dearer to it
            "usual_rate": rate,
            "standard": std,
        }

    def _floor(self, neg: Negotiation, full_cost: float | None, policy: Policy) -> float | None:
        if not full_cost:
            return None
        if neg.buyer.get("category_goal") in RELATIONSHIP_GOALS:
            margin = neg.buyer.get("sustainable_margin_pct") or 0
            return round(full_cost / (1 - margin / 100), 2)
        return round(full_cost * (1 + policy.markup), 2)

    def _target_c(self, neg, sid, terms, policy, profile, floor, current) -> float:
        """The C of our first ask: the deepest credible price on our C-optimal terms."""
        open_price = terms.get("unit_price")
        if open_price is None:
            return math.inf
        ref = min(open_price, current) if current else open_price
        candidates = [ref * (1 - policy.anchor)]
        alt_price = ((neg.buyer.get("alternative") or {}).get("terms") or {}).get("unit_price")
        if alt_price and alt_price < open_price:
            candidates.append(alt_price * 0.98)
        price = max(min(candidates), open_price * (1 - MAX_ANCHOR))  # deeper reads as an insult, not an ask
        if floor:
            price = max(price, floor)
        price = min(price, open_price)
        ideal = complete_offer(neg.case, self._optimise(neg, sid, {**terms, "unit_price": round(price, 2)}))
        return min(neg.cost(sid, ideal), neg.cost(sid, terms))

    # ------------------------------------------------------------------ per thread
    def decide(self, neg: Negotiation, supplier_id: str) -> Decision:
        t, plan = neg.threads[supplier_id], self.tplans[supplier_id]
        if not t.live:
            return Decision.drop(supplier_id, f"thread {t.status}")
        self._learn(neg, supplier_id, plan)
        sheet_id, theirs = t.standing
        if theirs.get("unit_price") is None or not math.isfinite(plan.target_c):
            return Decision.hold(supplier_id, "no price to negotiate on")
        if t.status == "agreed":
            return Decision.hold(supplier_id, "agreed")
        rounds_left = neg.case.get("round_limit", 10) - t.rounds_used
        if rounds_left <= 1:
            return Decision.hold(supplier_id, "last round: keep it for the close")
        if neg.seconds_to_deadline() < 120:
            return Decision.hold(supplier_id, "the deadline is near")

        their_c = neg.cost(supplier_id, theirs)
        if t.status == "final_offer":
            if plan.probed_final or not self._may_probe(neg, supplier_id, their_c):
                return Decision.hold(supplier_id, "final offer")
            plan.probed_final = True
            ask_c = their_c - 0.35 * max(0.0, their_c - (plan.our_c[-1] if plan.our_c else plan.target_c))
            return self._offer(neg, supplier_id, plan, theirs, ask_c, their_c, probe=True)

        if plan.stalls >= 3:
            return Decision.hold(supplier_id, "the supplier stopped moving", their_c=their_c)
        ask_c = self._next_c(neg, supplier_id, plan, their_c)
        if ask_c >= their_c * (1 - DONE_EPS):
            return Decision.hold(supplier_id, "their offer meets our ask", ask_c=ask_c, their_c=their_c)
        return self._offer(neg, supplier_id, plan, theirs, ask_c, their_c)

    def _learn(self, neg: Negotiation, sid: str, plan: Plan) -> None:
        """Read what came back since we last looked: argument checks, stalls, a cost breakdown."""
        t = neg.threads[sid]
        replies = t.supplier_messages
        for reply in replies[plan.seen_replies :]:
            for res in reply.get("claim_results") or []:
                i, result = res.get("index"), res.get("result")
                if not isinstance(i, int) or not 0 <= i < len(plan.last_claims):
                    continue
                kind = plan.last_claims[i].kind
                if result == "contradicted":
                    self.banned_case_kinds.add(kind)
                elif result == "irrelevant":
                    plan.banned_kinds.add(kind)
            if not plan.breakdown_read:
                self._read_breakdown(neg, sid, plan, reply)
        if len(replies) > plan.seen_replies and plan.seen_replies > 0:
            path = [neg.cost(sid, (m.get("term_sheets") or [{}])[0].get("terms") or {}) for m in replies]
            path = [c for c in path if math.isfinite(c)]
            if len(path) >= 2:
                moved = path[-2] - path[-1]
                plan.stalls = plan.stalls + 1 if moved <= path[-2] * STALL_EPS else 0
        plan.seen_replies = len(replies)

    def _read_breakdown(self, neg: Negotiation, sid: str, plan: Plan, reply: dict) -> None:
        """A cost breakdown XLSX: the supplier's own cost per unit is the floor it will not go below."""
        for att in reply.get("attachments") or []:
            name = (att.get("name") or "").lower()
            if not name.endswith(".xlsx") or "breakdown" not in name or not att.get("text"):
                continue
            full = parse_breakdown(att["text"])
            price = neg.threads[sid].standing[1].get("unit_price")
            if not full or not price or not 0.3 * price < full < price * 1.05:
                continue
            plan.breakdown_read = True
            plan.full_cost = full
            # where its margin costs us C, the relationship term now prices it exactly; elsewhere the
            # breakdown is its own account of cost - information, not a floor that forces our hand
            self._estimate_supplier(neg, sid, full, plan.profile)
            neg.recorder.event(
                "breakdown_read", session_id=neg.session_id, supplier_id=sid, full_cost=full, floor=plan.floor_price
            )
            log.info("%s: cost breakdown says full cost %.2f, floor %s", sid, full, plan.floor_price)

    def _next_c(self, neg: Negotiation, sid: str, plan: Plan, their_c: float) -> float:
        """Boulware over the rounds we can still play, capped by what the supplier gave last."""
        if not plan.our_c:
            return plan.target_c
        t = neg.threads[sid]
        last = plan.our_c[-1]
        budget = self._round_budget(neg, sid)
        progress = min(1.0, t.rounds_used / max(1, budget - 1))
        curve = plan.target_c + (their_c - plan.target_c) * progress**plan.policy.beta
        by_time = max(0.0, curve - last)
        theirs_path = self._their_c_path(neg, sid)
        their_move = theirs_path[-2] - theirs_path[-1] if len(theirs_path) >= 2 else 0.0
        if plan.stalls == 1:
            step = 0.0  # no move from it, no move from us
        elif plan.stalls == 2:
            step = by_time * 0.5  # break the deadlock once, gently
        else:
            step = min(plan.policy.reciprocity * max(their_move, 0.0), max(by_time, 0.3 * max(their_move, 0.0)))
        return min(last + step, their_c)

    def _round_budget(self, neg: Negotiation, sid: str) -> int:
        """Messages we can still expect to play in this thread: the round limit, or the clock."""
        t = neg.threads[sid]
        limit = neg.case.get("round_limit", 10)
        left = neg.seconds_to_deadline() - 120  # the runner closes before the cap
        if math.isfinite(left):
            per_round = max(15.0, neg.recorder.metrics.mean("supplier.reply_seconds") or 30.0) + 3.0
            limit = min(limit, t.rounds_used + max(1, int(left / per_round)))
        return limit

    def _their_c_path(self, neg: Negotiation, sid: str) -> list[float]:
        out = []
        for m in neg.threads[sid].supplier_messages:
            sheets = m.get("term_sheets") or []
            if sheets:
                c = neg.cost(sid, sheets[0]["terms"])
                if math.isfinite(c):
                    out.append(c)
        return out

    def _may_probe(self, neg: Negotiation, sid: str, their_c: float) -> bool:
        """Push a final offer once - only when its walking away would cost us little."""
        t = neg.threads[sid]
        if neg.case.get("round_limit", 10) - t.rounds_used < 2 or neg.seconds_to_deadline() < 180:
            return False
        for other, ot in neg.threads.items():
            if other != sid and ot.live and ot.standing[0] and not accept_problems(neg, other, ot.standing[0]):
                return True  # a rival offer we could take instead
        return math.isfinite(neg.c_alt) and neg.c_alt <= their_c * 1.01

    # ------------------------------------------------------------------ the offer
    def _offer(self, neg, sid, plan, theirs, ask_c, their_c, probe: bool = False) -> Decision:
        sheets = self._sheets(neg, sid, plan, theirs, ask_c, their_c)
        if not sheets:
            return Decision.hold(sid, "no valid term sheet below their offer")
        plan.our_c.append(neg.cost(sid, sheets[0]["terms"]))
        claims = self._choose_claims(neg, sid, plan, first=not plan.last_claims and neg.threads[sid].rounds_used == 0)
        plan.last_claims = claims
        message = self._write(neg, plan, sheets, claims, probe)
        return Decision(
            "message",
            sid,
            message=message,
            rationale={
                "round": neg.threads[sid].rounds_used + 1,
                "goal": neg.buyer.get("category_goal"),
                "traits": sorted(plan.profile.traits),
                "ask_c": round(ask_c, 2),
                "their_c": round(their_c, 2),
                "target_c": round(plan.target_c, 2),
                "stalls": plan.stalls,
                "probe": probe,
                "c_sheets": [neg.cost(sid, s["terms"]) for s in sheets],
                "claims": [c.kind for c in claims],
            },
        )

    def _sheets(self, neg, sid, plan, theirs, ask_c, their_c) -> list[dict]:
        """Up to three packages that all cost us `ask_c`: ours, a trade it values, a pure price move."""
        case = neg.case
        base = {**theirs, "unit_price": theirs["unit_price"]}
        ideal = complete_offer(case, self._optimise(neg, sid, base))
        variants = [ideal]
        trade = self._trade_terms(neg, sid, plan, ideal)
        if trade:
            variants.append(trade)
        variants.append(complete_offer(case, dict(theirs)))  # its own terms: a pure price move
        out, seen = [], set()
        for terms in variants:
            priced = complete_offer(case, {**terms, "unit_price": self._iso_cost_price(neg, sid, terms, ask_c)})
            key = repr(sorted(priced.items(), key=lambda kv: kv[0]))
            if key in seen or not priced.get("unit_price") or not neg.keeps_must_haves(sid, priced):
                continue
            if plan.floor_price and priced["unit_price"] < plan.floor_price * 0.97:
                continue  # below what it can sell at: an insult, not an offer
            if neg.cost(sid, priced) >= their_c:
                continue
            seen.add(key)
            out.append({"terms": priced})
        return out[:3]

    def _trade_terms(self, neg, sid, plan, ideal: dict) -> dict | None:
        """Our terms with the levers the supplier values given to it (the price pays for them)."""
        options = neg.case.get("term_options", {})
        negotiable = neg.case["negotiable"]
        trade = dict(ideal)
        changed = False
        for f in plan.policy.trade_first or ("payment_days",):
            if f not in negotiable or not options.get(f):
                continue
            values = [v for v in options[f] if v is not None]
            if not values:
                continue
            if f == "payment_days":
                pick = min(values)  # early payment: cash for the supplier
            elif f == "contract_months":
                pick = max(values)  # security; beyond our horizon it costs us nothing
            elif f == "volume_per_year":
                need = neg.buyer.get("need_per_year", 0)
                fitting = [v for v in values if v <= need] or values
                pick = max(fitting)
            else:
                continue
            if trade.get(f) != pick and neg.keeps_must_haves(sid, {**trade, f: pick}):
                trade[f] = pick
                changed = True
        return trade if changed else None

    # ------------------------------------------------------------------ arguments and words
    def _choose_claims(self, neg, sid, plan, first: bool) -> list[Evidence]:
        banned = plan.banned_kinds | self.banned_case_kinds
        pool = [e for e in plan.evidence if e.kind not in banned]
        rival = self._rival_evidence(neg, sid)
        if rival and "rival_offer" not in banned:
            pool.insert(0, rival)
        prefer: list[str] = []
        for key in [*sorted(plan.profile.traits), neg.buyer.get("category_goal", "")]:
            prefer += EVIDENCE_FIRST.get(key, [])
        pool.sort(key=lambda e: (e.kind not in prefer, -e.strength))
        picked, kinds = [], set()
        limit = plan.policy.claims_first if first else 1
        for e in pool:
            if len(picked) >= limit:
                break
            if e.kind == "rival_offer":
                if any((sid, r) in self.used_rival_refs for r in e.refs):
                    continue
            elif any(r in self.used_refs for r in e.refs) or e.kind in kinds:
                continue
            picked.append(e)
            kinds.add(e.kind)
        for e in picked:
            if e.kind == "rival_offer":
                self.used_rival_refs.update((sid, r) for r in e.refs)
            else:
                self.used_refs.update(e.refs)
        return picked

    def _write(self, neg, plan: Plan, sheets: list[dict], claims: list[Evidence], probe: bool) -> dict:
        p, case = plan.profile, neg.case

        elif plan.stalls:

49	"""The strategy interface. The runner calls it; `Negotiation` holds the state it reads.
50	
51	Per thread the runner asks `decide(neg, supplier_id)`:
52	  message    send this e-mail (subject, body, term sheets, refs)

56	  walk_away  close the case without a deal

151	"""Tactical buyer: category goal + supplier profile -> tactics; tit-for-tat Boulware concessions in C.
152	
153	Ideas taken from ASTRA (Kwon et al., github.com/DSincerity/ASTRA-NegoAgent) - the tactics, not the
154	code: a model of the opponent, an optimiser over the published cost function, several offers of
155	equal value to us that differ in what they give the supplier, and concessions that answer the
156	supplier's (no move from it, no move from us).
157	
158	Per case (prepare):
159	  - the category goal sets the policy: how deep we anchor, how slowly we concede (Boulware beta),
160	    how much of the supplier's move we answer (reciprocity), whether we protect its margin;
161	  - the supplier's profile (profile.py) adjusts it: idle capacity -> anchor deeper; fully booked or
162	    below cost -> shallower; cash-short -> offer early payment; hedged -> skip index arguments ...;
163	  - target C: the deepest credible price (anchor, should-cost, history, alternative), never below
164	    what the supplier can sell at (its full cost, plus the sustainable margin where squeezing costs C).
165	
166	Per round (decide), all in C (our total cost, the score's currency):
167	  - their concession = drop of C of their standing sheet; ours = drop of the C we ask for;
168	  - next ask: the Boulware curve over the rounds we can still play (round limit and the clock),
169	    capped by reciprocity - if they did not move, we hold (then a half step to break a deadlock;
170	    the third stall settles the thread);
171	  - up to three term sheets at that same C: our C-optimal terms; a trade the supplier values
172	    (early payment for the cash-short, a long commitment for those who want volume or security);
173	    a pure price move on its own terms. Whatever it agrees to costs us the same.
174	  - arguments: checkable evidence picked by the profile; what came back irrelevant or contradicted
175	    is not used again.
176	Closing: the cheapest standing sheet that passes the guards (guards.py), else walk away; a
177	`final_offer` is probed once with a trade when walking would cost us little.

416	        for reply in replies[plan.seen_replies :]:
417	            for res in reply.get("claim_results") or []:
418	                i, result = res.get("index"), res.get("result")
419	                if not isinstance(i, int) or not 0 <= i < len(plan.last_claims):
420	                    continue
421	                kind = plan.last_claims[i].kind
422	                if result == "contradicted":
423	                    self.banned_case_kinds.add(kind)
424	                elif result == "irrelevant":
425	                    plan.banned_kinds.add(kind)
426	            if not plan.breakdown_read:
427	                self._read_breakdown(neg, sid, plan, reply)
428	        if len(replies) > plan.seen_replies and plan.seen_replies > 0:
429	            path = [neg.cost(sid, (m.get("term_sheets") or [{}])[0].get("terms") or {}) for m in replies]
430	            path = [c for c in path if math.isfinite(c)]
431	            if len(path) >= 2:
432	                moved = path[-2] - path[-1]
433	                plan.stalls = plan.stalls + 1 if moved <= path[-2] * STALL_EPS else 0
434	        plan.seen_replies = len(replies)
435	
436	    def _read_breakdown(self, neg: Negotiation, sid: str, plan: Plan, reply: dict) -> None:
437	        """A cost breakdown XLSX: the supplier's own cost per unit is the floor it will not go below."""
438	        for att in reply.get("attachments") or []:
439	            name = (att.get("name") or "").lower()
440	            if not name.endswith(".xlsx") or "breakdown" not in name or not att.get("text"):
441	                continue
442	            full = parse_breakdown(att["text"])
443	            price = neg.threads[sid].standing[1].get("unit_price")
444	            if not full or not price or not 0.3 * price < full < price * 1.05:
445	                continue
446	            plan.breakdown_read = True
447	            plan.full_cost = full
448	            # where its margin costs us C, the relationship term now prices it exactly; elsewhere the
449	            # breakdown is its own account of cost - information, not a floor that forces our hand
450	            self._estimate_supplier(neg, sid, full, plan.profile)
451	            neg.recorder.event(
452	                "breakdown_read", session_id=neg.session_id, supplier_id=sid, full_cost=full, floor=plan.floor_price
453	            )
454	            log.info("%s: cost breakdown says full cost %.2f, floor %s", sid, full, plan.floor_price)
455	
456	    def _next_c(self, neg: Negotiation, sid: str, plan: Plan, their_c: float) -> float:
457	        """Boulware over the rounds we can still play, capped by what the supplier gave last."""
458	        if not plan.our_c:
459	            return plan.target_c
460	        t = neg.threads[sid]
461	        last = plan.our_c[-1]
462	        budget = self._round_budget(neg, sid)
463	        progress = min(1.0, t.rounds_used / max(1, budget - 1))
464	        curve = plan.target_c + (their_c - plan.target_c) * progress**plan.policy.beta
465	        by_time = max(0.0, curve - last)
466	        theirs_path = self._their_c_path(neg, sid)
467	        their_move = theirs_path[-2] - theirs_path[-1] if len(theirs_path) >= 2 else 0.0
468	        if plan.stalls == 1:
469	            step = 0.0  # no move from it, no move from us
470	        elif plan.stalls == 2:
471	            step = by_time * 0.5  # break the deadlock once, gently
472	        else:
473	            step = min(plan.policy.reciprocity * max(their_move, 0.0), max(by_time, 0.3 * max(their_move, 0.0)))
474	        return min(last + step, their_c)
475	
476	    def _round_budget(self, neg: Negotiation, sid: str) -> int:
477	        """Messages we can still expect to play in this thread: the round limit, or the clock."""
478	        t = neg.threads[sid]
479	        limit = neg.case.get("round_limit", 10)
480	        left = neg.seconds_to_deadline() - 120  # the runner closes before the cap
481	        if math.isfinite(left):
482	            per_round = max(15.0, neg.recorder.metrics.mean("supplier.reply_seconds") or 30.0) + 3.0
483	            limit = min(limit, t.rounds_used + max(1, int(left / per_round)))
484	        return limit
485	
486	    def _their_c_path(self, neg: Negotiation, sid: str) -> list[float]:
487	        out = []
488	        for m in neg.threads[sid].supplier_messages:
489	            sheets = m.get("term_sheets") or []
490	            if sheets:
491	                c = neg.cost(sid, sheets[0]["terms"])
492	                if math.isfinite(c):
493	                    out.append(c)
494	        return out
495	
496	    def _may_probe(self, neg: Negotiation, sid: str, their_c: float) -> bool:
497	        """Push a final offer once - only when its walking away would cost us little."""
498	        t = neg.threads[sid]
499	        if neg.case.get("round_limit", 10) - t.rounds_used < 2 or neg.seconds_to_deadline() < 180:
500	            return False
501	        for other, ot in neg.threads.items():
502	            if other != sid and ot.live and ot.standing[0] and not accept_problems(neg, other, ot.standing[0]):
503	                return True  # a rival offer we could take instead
504	        return math.isfinite(neg.c_alt) and neg.c_alt <= their_c * 1.01
505	
506	    # ------------------------------------------------------------------ the offer
507	    def _offer(self, neg, sid, plan, theirs, ask_c, their_c, probe: bool = False) -> Decision:
508	        sheets = self._sheets(neg, sid, plan, theirs, ask_c, their_c)
509	        if not sheets:
510	            return Decision.hold(sid, "no valid term sheet below their offer")
511	        plan.our_c.append(neg.cost(sid, sheets[0]["terms"]))
512	        claims = self._choose_claims(neg, sid, plan, first=not plan.last_claims and neg.threads[sid].rounds_used == 0)
513	        plan.last_claims = claims
514	        message = self._write(neg, plan, sheets, claims, probe)
515	        return Decision(
516	            "message",
517	            sid,
518	            message=message,
519	            rationale={
520	                "round": neg.threads[sid].rounds_used + 1,
521	                "goal": neg.buyer.get("category_goal"),
522	                "traits": sorted(plan.profile.traits),
523	                "ask_c": round(ask_c, 2),
524	                "their_c": round(their_c, 2),
525	                "target_c": round(plan.target_c, 2),
526	                "stalls": plan.stalls,
527	                "probe": probe,
528	                "c_sheets": [neg.cost(sid, s["terms"]) for s in sheets],
529	                "claims": [c.kind for c in claims],
530	            },
531	        )
532	
533	    def _sheets(self, neg, sid, plan, theirs, ask_c, their_c) -> list[dict]:
534	        """Up to three packages that all cost us `ask_c`: ours, a trade it values, a pure price move."""
535	        case = neg.case
536	        base = {**theirs, "unit_price": theirs["unit_price"]}
537	        ideal = complete_offer(case, self._optimise(neg, sid, base))
538	        variants = [ideal]
539	        trade = self._trade_terms(neg, sid, plan, ideal)
540	        if trade:
541	            variants.append(trade)
542	        variants.append(complete_offer(case, dict(theirs)))  # its own terms: a pure price move
543	        out, seen = [], set()
544	        for terms in variants:
545	            priced = complete_offer(case, {**terms, "unit_price": self._iso_cost_price(neg, sid, terms, ask_c)})
546	            key = repr(sorted(priced.items(), key=lambda kv: kv[0]))
547	            if key in seen or not priced.get("unit_price") or not neg.keeps_must_haves(sid, priced):
548	                continue
549	            if plan.floor_price and priced["unit_price"] < plan.floor_price * 0.97:
550	                continue  # below what it can sell at: an insult, not an offer
551	            if neg.cost(sid, priced) >= their_c:
552	                continue
553	            seen.add(key)
554	            out.append({"terms": priced})
555	        return out[:3]
556	
557	    def _trade_terms(self, neg, sid, plan, ideal: dict) -> dict | None:
558	        """Our terms with the levers the supplier values given to it (the price pays for them)."""
559	        options = neg.case.get("term_options", {})
560	        negotiable = neg.case["negotiable"]
561	        trade = dict(ideal)
562	        changed = False
563	        for f in plan.policy.trade_first or ("payment_days",):
564	            if f not in negotiable or not options.get(f):
565	                continue
566	            values = [v for v in options[f] if v is not None]
567	            if not values:
568	                continue
569	            if f == "payment_days":
570	                pick = min(values)  # early payment: cash for the supplier
571	            elif f == "contract_months":
572	                pick = max(values)  # security; beyond our horizon it costs us nothing
573	            elif f == "volume_per_year":
574	                need = neg.buyer.get("need_per_year", 0)
575	                fitting = [v for v in values if v <= need] or values
576	                pick = max(fitting)
577	            else:
578	                continue
579	            if trade.get(f) != pick and neg.keeps_must_haves(sid, {**trade, f: pick}):
580	                trade[f] = pick
581	                changed = True
582	        return trade if changed else None
583	
584	    # ------------------------------------------------------------------ arguments and words
585	    def _choose_claims(self, neg, sid, plan, first: bool) -> list[Evidence]:
586	        banned = plan.banned_kinds | self.banned_case_kinds
587	        pool = [e for e in plan.evidence if e.kind not in banned]
588	        rival = self._rival_evidence(neg, sid)
589	        if rival and "rival_offer" not in banned:
590	            pool.insert(0, rival)
591	        prefer: list[str] = []
592	        for key in [*sorted(plan.profile.traits), neg.buyer.get("category_goal", "")]:
593	            prefer += EVIDENCE_FIRST.get(key, [])
594	        pool.sort(key=lambda e: (e.kind not in prefer, -e.strength))
595	        picked, kinds = [], set()
596	        limit = plan.policy.claims_first if first else 1
597	        for e in pool:
598	            if len(picked) >= limit:
599	                break
600	            if e.kind == "rival_offer":
601	                if any((sid, r) in self.used_rival_refs for r in e.refs):
602	                    continue
603	            elif any(r in self.used_refs for r in e.refs) or e.kind in kinds:
604	                continue
605	            picked.append(e)
606	            kinds.add(e.kind)
607	        for e in picked:
608	            if e.kind == "rival_offer":
609	                self.used_rival_refs.update((sid, r) for r in e.refs)
610	            else:
611	                self.used_refs.update(e.refs)
612	        return picked
613	
614	    def _write(self, neg, plan: Plan, sheets: list[dict], claims: list[Evidence], probe: bool) -> dict:
615	        p, case = plan.profile, neg.case
616	        first = neg.threads[plan.supplier_id].rounds_used == 0
617	        lines = [f"Dear {plan.name} team,", ""]
618	        if first:
619	            if p.has("relationship") or neg.buyer.get("category_goal") in RELATIONSHIP_GOALS:
620	                lines.append("thank you for your quote and for the reliable cooperation we value.")
621	            else:
622	                lines.append("thank you for your quote. We have reviewed it carefully against our data.")
623	        elif probe:
624	            lines.append("thank you - we are close. One last step from your side and we can sign.")
625	        elif plan.stalls:
626	            lines.append("thank you for your reply. We see no movement yet, so we propose a different structure.")
627	        else:
628	            lines.append("thank you for your reply and the step towards us. We move as well.")
629	        lines += [c.sentence for c in claims]
630	        if not plan.asked_breakdown and (first or p.has("open_book")) and not plan.breakdown_read:
631	            lines.append("Could you send us a cost breakdown for this part?")
632	            plan.asked_breakdown = True
633	        if len(sheets) > 1:
634	            if p.has("cash_short"):
635	                lines.append("If faster payment helps you, one option below pays early.")
636	            elif any(f in plan.policy.trade_first for f in ("contract_months", "volume_per_year")):
637	                lines.append("We are ready to commit for longer if the price reflects it.")
638	        lines += ["", "We can award on any of these options:" if len(sheets) > 1 else "Our proposal:"]
639	        for i, sheet in enumerate(sheets):
640	            lines.append(f"Option {chr(65 + i)}: {describe(case, sheet['terms'])}")
641	        lines += ["", SIGNATURE]
642	        return {
643	            "subject": case.get("title", "Your quote"),
644	            "body": "\n".join(lines),
645	            "term_sheets": sheets,
646	            "refs": sorted({r for c in claims for r in c.refs}),
647	        }
648	
649	    def keepalive(self, neg: Negotiation, supplier_id: str) -> dict | None:
650	        """A held thread's clock runs while others negotiate: a harmless question keeps it alive."""
651	        t = neg.threads[supplier_id]
652	        if neg.case.get("round_limit", 10) - t.rounds_used <= 2:
653	            return None
654	        plan = self.tplans[supplier_id]
655	        asks = [
656	            "could you confirm your delivery capacity for our annual volume?",
657	            "could you confirm the lead time you can commit to for the first call-off?",
658	            "could you confirm the validity of your offer?",
659	        ]
660	        question = asks[t.rounds_used % len(asks)]
661	        return {
662	            "subject": neg.case.get("title", "Your quote"),
663	            "body": f"Dear {plan.name} team,\n\nthank you. While we complete our evaluation: {question}\n\n{SIGNATURE}",
664	        }
665	
666	    # ------------------------------------------------------------------ closing
667	    def conclude(self, neg: Negotiation) -> Decision:
668	        best = None
669	        rejected = {}
670	        for sid, t in neg.threads.items():
671	            sheet_id, terms = t.standing
672	            if not sheet_id or t.closed or t.status in ("walked_away", "no_bid"):
673	                continue
674	            if problems := accept_problems(neg, sid, sheet_id):
675	                rejected[sid] = problems
676	                continue
677	            c = neg.cost(sid, terms)
678	            if best is None or c < best[0]:
679	                best = (c, sid, sheet_id)
680	        if best:
681	            return Decision(
682	                "accept",
683	                best[1],
684	                term_sheet_id=best[2],
685	                rationale={"c": best[0], "c_alt": neg.c_alt, "rejected": rejected, "why": "cheapest safe sheet"},
686	            )
687	        return Decision(
688	            "walk_away",
689	            next(iter(neg.threads)),
690	            rationale={"c_alt": neg.c_alt, "rejected": rejected, "why": "no sheet passes the guards"},
691	        )
692	
693	
694	def parse_breakdown(text: str) -> float | None:
695	    """Full cost per unit from a cost-breakdown sheet: the EUR elements except margin and totals."""
696	    skip = ("margin", "profit", "gewinn", "unit price", "price", "total", "sum", "element")
697	    total, found = 0.0, False
698	    for line in text.splitlines():
699	        cells = [c.strip() for c in line.split("|")]
700	        if len(cells) < 2 or not cells[0] or cells[0].startswith("["):
701	            continue
702	        if any(s in cells[0].lower() for s in skip):
703	            continue
704	        try:
705	            value = float(cells[1])
706	        except ValueError:
707	            continue
708	        total += value
709	        found = True
710	    return round(total, 2) if found and total > 0 else None
711	
712	
713	def _k(value: float) -> str:
714	    return f"{value:,.0f}" if math.isfinite(value) else "inf"

return cls(**{**settings.__dict__, **overrides}) if overrides else settings
"""The strategy interface. The runner calls it; `Negotiation` holds the state it reads.

Per thread the runner asks `decide(neg, supplier_id)`:
  message    send this e-mail (subject, body, term sheets, refs)
  hold       this thread is settled for now (agreed, final offer, close enough, out of rounds)
  drop       this thread is over for us (walked away, no bid, hopeless)
  accept     close the case on this supplier's standing term sheet
  walk_away  close the case without a deal
When every thread is held or dropped, `conclude(neg)` makes the closing move (accept or walk away).
While other threads still negotiate, a held thread's 60 s clock keeps running: `keepalive` returns a
message that keeps it alive (or None to let it be).
"""

from dataclasses import dataclass, field
from typing import Literal, Protocol

from negotiator.session import Negotiation

Kind = Literal["message", "hold", "drop", "accept", "walk_away"]


@dataclass
class Decision:
    kind: Kind
    supplier_id: str | None = None
    message: dict | None = None
    term_sheet_id: str | None = None
    rationale: dict = field(default_factory=dict)

    @classmethod
    def hold(cls, supplier_id: str, why: str, **extra) -> "Decision":
        return cls("hold", supplier_id, rationale={"why": why, **extra})

    @classmethod
    def drop(cls, supplier_id: str, why: str, **extra) -> "Decision":
        return cls("drop", supplier_id, rationale={"why": why, **extra})


class Strategy(Protocol):
    name: str

    def prepare(self, neg: Negotiation) -> None: ...

    def decide(self, neg: Negotiation, supplier_id: str) -> Decision: ...

    def conclude(self, neg: Negotiation) -> Decision: ...

    def keepalive(self, neg: Negotiation, supplier_id: str) -> dict | None: ...
"""Strategies by name. Add yours here: any class with prepare/decide/conclude/keepalive (see base.py)."""

from collections.abc import Callable
